sentences.text: The present petition is filed under section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR bearing no. 0443/2014 dated 09.05.2014 registered under sections 498A/406 IPC at P.S. Alipur along with consequential judicial proceedings.
2. Issue notice.
3. Mr. Yudhvir Singh Chauhan, Additional Public Prosecutor assisted by the Investigating Officer SI Mohan Lal, P.S. Alipur, accepts notice on behalf of the State/respondent no. 1.
The respondent no. 2 is present in person along with the counsel and accepts notice.
4. The petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 got married on 07.05.2006 at Delhi according to Hindu rites and ceremonies and out of their marriage, two children were born.

sentences.text: The respondent no. 2 due to matrimonial differences
, got registered FIR bearing no. 0443/2014 under sections 498A/406 IPC at P.S. Alipur wherein the petitioners were implicated.
The parents of the petitioner no. 1 i.e. the petitioners no. 2 & 3 have already expired.
The petitioners no. 4 to 7 are the family members/relatives of the petitioner no. 1.
The petitioners and the respondent no. 2 are identified by the Investigating Officer SI Mohan Lal, P.S. Alipur and by their respective counsel.
After conclusion of investigation, the charge-sheet was filed and the trial is stated to be pending in the court of Ms. Preeti, MM (Mahila Court), North, Rohini Courts, Delhi/Successor Courts.

entities.text: MM (Mahila Court), North, Rohini Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. The petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 have settled their pending disputes and are living together in their matrimonial home along with their minor children since the year 2016 with mutual love, affection and understanding.

7. The respective counsel for the petitioners and the respondent no. 2 stated that the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 are living together since the year 2016 after addressing their pending disputes with mutual love, affection and understanding as such, the present petition be allowed and FIR bearing no. 0443/2014 be quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.

8. The respondent no.2 stated that she has settled with the petitioners out of her own free will and without any force, fear or coercion and is living together with petitioner no.1 since the year 2016 with mutual love, affection and understanding as such, she does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no.0443/2014 along with consequential judicial proceedings is quashed.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/10/2023 at 21:20:32 9.

The Additional Public Prosecutor for the State/respondent no. 1 stated that under the given facts and circumstances of the case, he does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no.0443/2014 is quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.

10. The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have already settled their pending disputes and are living together since the year 2016 along with their minor children in their matrimonial home with mutual love, affection and understanding.
No useful purpose shall be served if the proceedings arising out of the present FIR are allowed to be continued.

After considering all facts, the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0443/2014 dated 09.05.2014 registered under sections 498A/406 IPC at P.S. Alipur is quashed along with consequential proceedings including judicial proceedings stated to be pending in the court of Ms. Preeti, MM (Mahila Court), North, Rohini Courts, Delhi/Successor Courts.

entities.text: MM (Mahila Court), North, Rohini Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 11. The present petition along with pending application, stands disposed of.
DR. SUDHIR KUMAR JAIN, J OCTOBER 16, 2023 Sk/ak
